analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md: it updates the date and adds a GPT-OSS decode command-buffer section (head lines 4816-4826, in the patch excerpt). The two supplied units (head lines 2841-3592) are unchanged surrounding documentation, and the changed range itself is outside both units. The added section describes performance tuning only: it commits a Metal command buffer every 100 operations with no input-size bound, and prefill keeps MLX defaults. It does not change authentication, attestation, encryption, key handling, coordinator or provider trust boundaries, prefix-cache storage, or the T-041 posture (HMAC-keyed names, 30-minute TTL, SEC-035). The surrounding text mentions cluster, cache-tenant partition, cancellation and App-Attest-adjacent behavior, but the diff does not touch any of it, so I did not re-audit those claims. This is a documentation-only change with no new attack surface. One limit: the actual source for `GPTOSSDecodeCommandBuffers` and `CBv2DecodeCommandBufferLimitsProviding` was not supplied, so the claim that results do not depend on the partitioning is unverified. That is a correctness and availability question, not a demonstrated security regression. No findings.
